integrity_notes: Exact standard-library verification source and its observed output are bundled. No independent audit or external certification is represented as performed.
scientific_limitations: Only open two-row ladders. The minimum cardinality is prior work, while the full all-cardinality polynomial and optimum multiplicities are assessed here. The all-order proof uses a 16-state exact polynomial certificate and Cayley-Hamilton. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: Complete 1-limited-domination polynomials of open ladders
